title: Kagamine Len — A Treasure Chest Of Fun〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I really hope Rin's okay...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (The others said that we should give her some space for now, but I'm kinda worried...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (It's okay if I go take a peek to see how she's doing, right...?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Let's see... The plushies said that they saw Rin around here somewhere... Aha!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Oh no... She seems pretty sad.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (What should I do? I wanna cheer her up somehow, but I also don't want what I say to backfire...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Did someone just call my name just now?
Over here! Look this way!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, you guys were also worried and decided to see how she's doing?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sorry. I know I was the one who said we should give her some space...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But that didn't stop us from worrying about her. I mean, Rin's usually able to get back up on her own.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, what can we do to cheer her up?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think our best option is to redo the same show and get through it without any slipups...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... What if that makes things worse? She might try too hard and tense up or something.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Right...
So, for now, let's think of a way to cheer her up directly.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Whenever you feel sad, it's fairly natural to fall deeper and deeper into that abyss so to speak.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What you just said...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know how easy it is to fall deeper and deeper into this sort of abyss, so I'm very worried.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, our first step may be to help cheer her up by thinking of something that she can enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, that's it...!
The same thing might work for Rin!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The same thing?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What you guys just said reminded me of the time Emu was feeling really down. Remember?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! This is a pretty similar situation...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We agreed that only Emu herself can settle her own feelings, but we also agreed to help cheer her up a little in the meantime!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, and we suggested that she do something she truly loves...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Exactly! So, Rin might feel better if she does something she really loves!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Something she really loves?
Okay, let's take that and try coming up with some ideas!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh? Len...? Wait, you're all here...
What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin! We're about to go on all the rides and attractions in SEKAI! Come join us!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? But I...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Chugga-chugga-choo-choo!
Everyone, the train to take you on a tour of all the rides and attractions is here!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A train? Not the flying one?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes! Here's how you board!
Like this!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, I'll go next. There.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, this is just...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. We're gonna pretend to be the train that takes us around!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, we'll be able to go on all the rides and attractions you love so much!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len... You guys...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Chugga-chugga-chugga-chugga! Choo-choo!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like our driver is raring to go.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Now, you two, come aboard.
As the conductor, I belong at the back.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay! Rin, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay, we're all aboard!
Driver, take us away!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Roger! The Miku Miku Express is ready to depart! Choo-choo!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yay! Go go go!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, we're gonna trip over each others' feet if we're not careful!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Let's try to move in rhythm! One, two! One, two!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Nice idea, Len!
Miku, steady as she goes.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Choo-choo! (Okay!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha♪
Miku, you're more like the train than the driver!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Oh, Rin just laughed...!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Alright, let's keep this up and have as much fun as we can!)
